faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Workers register under a trade and complete a profile. Our admin team verifies them, and only then can customers find and book them for an appointment.
faq.a2: Every worker submits their trade, experience, rate and contact details. Our team reviews the submission and either approves it or sends it back with a reason.
faq.q3: How do I book a worker?
faq.a3: Browse verified workers, open a profile, then choose a date, time and address. The worker confirms the request from their dashboard.
faq.q4: What does it cost to join?
faq.a4: Creating an account is free for both workers and customers. Workers set their own hourly rate, which is shown up front on their profile.
faq.a5: The whole platform is available in English, Hindi and Kannada. You can switch language at any time from the menu at the top.

about.title: About BlueForce
about.subtitle: Connecting India's skilled blue-collar workers with the people who need them.
about.missionBody1: Skilled workers across India rely on word of mouth to find their next job, while people needing an electrician or a plumber rely on the same. BlueForce replaces that guesswork with verified profiles and direct appointments.
about.missionBody2: Workers keep control of their own rates and schedule. Customers get someone whose credentials have actually been checked. That's the whole idea.

trust.title: Trust first
trust.body: Every worker passes an admin review before a customer can book them. Verification is not optional.

dignity.title: Dignity of work
dignity.body: Skilled trades deserve proper profiles, clear rates and direct bookings — not middlemen taking a cut.

everyone.title: Built for everyone
everyone.body: Available in English, Hindi and Kannada, and designed to be usable on a basic phone.

simple.title: Straightforward
simple.body: Search, request, confirm. No job auctions, no bidding wars, no hidden charges.

howItWorks.title: How BlueForce works
howItWorks.subtitle: Verified blue-collar workers, booked in a few taps.

step1.title: Register as a worker
step1.body: Sign up and pick the trade you work in — electrician, plumber, carpenter and more.

step2.title: Complete your profile
step2.body: Add your experience, hourly rate, skills and city so customers know what you offer.

step3.title: Get verified
step3.body: Our admin team reviews every worker. You appear in search only once approved.

step4.title: Accept bookings
step4.body: Customers send appointment requests. Accept the ones that suit you and get to work.

step1.title: Search verified workers
step1.body: Filter by trade and city. Everyone you see has already passed our verification.

step2.title: Compare profiles
step2.body: Check experience, hourly rate, skills and ratings before you decide.

step3.title: Request an appointment
step3.body: Choose a date and time, add your address and describe the job.

step4.title: Get confirmed
step4.body: The worker accepts and their contact details unlock. Track it from your dashboard.
